notes: From SirBlacky21's diagnostics ZIP (#598), the first Intel desktop and first Gigabyte Z890 board: Z890 EAGLE WIFI7 (CSL Computer case) with ITE IT8696E Super I/O, whose voltages are unnamed (Voltage #1..#7, +3V Standby, CMOS Battery). Intel Core Ultra 9 285K (/intelcpu/0), RTX 5070 Ti (/gpu-nvidia/0, preferred) + Intel Graphics iGPU (/gpu-intel-integrated). 2x Kingston KF560C36-32 DDR5-6000.
